comment: What the warnings card says about the storm lights on the shore, by season and date (owner's pick on 20 Nov 2026, decision 0052: option A with the transitions). The date counts in German time. season comes from data/shore-lights.json via the forecast file (warnings.shoreLightsSeason). Read by the app (ShoreLightsSeason in ios/RowFrog/ShoreLights.swift, tested in ios/RowFrogTests/ShoreLightsSeasonTests.swift) and the website (shoreLightsState in web/public/app/logic.js, tested in web/tests/shorelights.test.mjs); change all three together.

states.on: The lights run: the row reads 'What the shore warning lights mean', as before.
states.off: 1 November to 14 March on a lake with season apr-oct: 'Storm lights off until 1 April'.
states.soon: 15 to 31 March on a lake with season apr-oct: 'Storm lights back on from 1 April'.
